description: Fork of exp071 (1.7088 @ 8K, 129.3M, leak fix via V2D->D2V on each block output, concat unembedder) adding sparse_scatter to qk_joint and out_proj only with n_sparse=8. v_lut keeps n_outputs=d_v=16 (sparse_scatter not applied — d_v=16 is already small, and balanced coverage greedy fails for n_per_row=8 of n_slots=16). Same nap/tph as exp071. Tests whether sparse_scatter on qk + out is free at exp071's shape.
